run_div2k_main: run the div2k module to generate fake DIV2K test images with random data for testing
generate_image_div2k: generate a fake PNG image in a specified subdirectory using _generate_image function
get_output_dir_div2k: get the output directory path for fake DIV2K test data under tfds_dir/testing/test_data/fake_examples/div2k
test_div2k_data: test the div2k fake data generation module by running main to populate test image directories
refactor_div2k_data: refactor the div2k module to support configurable image dimensions and additional dataset splits
